newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Volga-Dnepr begins regular passenger service.
newsitem.headline: Volga-Dnepr begins regular passenger service.

text.p: Leading Russian cargo airline Volga-Dnepr has begun its first regular passenger route between Moscow and its base in the central Russian city of Ulyanovsk, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
"The company is operating a 30-seat Yakovlev Yak-40 jet four times a week on the route," the statement said.

Volga-Dnepr has leased the plane from local private airline Simbirsk Aero, which had stopped its service in September due to its serious financial problems. The statement said Simbirsk Aero had $2.5 million of debts.
Volga-Dnepr operates 12 freighters making regular international and domestic cargo routes.
